# Art by Raposo

> Fineline and blackwork tattoo artist in Miami, Florida. Original, custom tattoo projects with fine lines, florals, soft shading and delicate compositions. Sessions by appointment only; quotes are requested through the website form and continued on Instagram Direct.

## About

- Artist: Raposo
- Specialties: fine line, floral, minimalist / small tattoos, black & grey, custom ideas
- Location: 450 NW 28th St, Miami, Florida, USA
- Bookings: by appointment only
- Languages on the website: English, Portuguese, Spanish

## How to request a tattoo quote

1. Open the quote form on the website: https://art.by.raposo.casteloads.com/#orcamento
2. Answer three short questions: tattoo style, the idea and exact body placement, and contact details (first name, last name, phone; email optional).
3. Send the summary to Raposo on Instagram Direct: https://ig.me/m/art.by.raposo

Prices depend on size, placement and detail, so they are given individually after the idea is reviewed.
